title: A shared local-search library
body: search.improve(v, k, t, blocks=None, seconds, seed) returns the smallest valid covering it finds in that time. Every record task can build on it, so make it good: incremental bookkeeping of how often each t-subset is covered, simulated annealing (Nurmela and Ostergard's method is the classic), restarts. Split it if it helps (a sketch: bookkeeping, moves, schedule).

title: C(14,5,3): beat 43 blocks
body: Fewest 5-subsets of {1..14} covering every 3-subset. Known record 43 (Nurmela and Ostergard, simulated annealing, 1996); best known lower bound 37. Put your search code in work/c14-5-3/ and the covering in solutions/C14-5-3.txt.
